scenes.headline: How one latent decodes a picture and its 3D
scenes.sub: Generate inside a geometry model's features, then read out both.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Nova! Most video generators paint pictures, then guess the 3D. GAE generates where geometry already lives. Here's how.

scenes.text: Generate in a latent that a geometry model can already read, then decode picture and 3D from the same state. The geometry never sees the picture.
scenes.say: Generate in a latent a geometry model already reads. Decode the picture and the 3D from that same state. The geometry never sees the picture.

steps.say: Start with Depth Anything 3, frozen. It reads frames into four levels of rich features.
A codec squeezes those into sixty-four channels on the same patch grid. Only the channels shrink, never the grid.
Then a flow model generates in that space: from noise, guided by a reference image and camera rays, to a latent per view.

scenes.label: condition number: raw Depth Anything level 3, then the 64-channel latent
scenes.say: Why compress? Conditioning. The raw features' condition number is six point six times ten to the sixteenth: numerically singular. The latent's is fifty-three.

steps.say: To read a latent out, a shared trunk decodes it once.
One fork is a learned RGB head, two hundred and three million parameters, that paints the pixels.
The other rebuilds four feature levels for Depth Anything's frozen head, which reads depth and camera rays.

steps.note: No path runs from the pixels to the geometry
steps.say: No path runs from the pixels to the geometry. Delete the RGB head and you'd get the same cloud, in grey.

scenes.title: Where every point comes from
scenes.say: Each point is built from the geometry readout alone.

parts.note: the camera centre, decoded from the ray
parts.say: Origin: the camera centre, from the decoded ray.

parts.note: metric depth from the frozen head
parts.say: Plus depth, from the frozen head,
times the ray's direction. The picture only sets each point's colour.

scenes.text: Geometry is read, not reconstructed: picture and 3D fork from one latent, and the points never depend on the pixels.
scenes.say: Geometry is read, not reconstructed. Picture and 3D fork from one latent, and the points never touch the pixels.

recap: Generate inside Depth Anything 3's compressed features
One trunk, two heads: pixels and geometry
Points are origin plus depth times direction
scenes.say: To recap: generate where geometry lives, fork two readouts, and build points from rays.
